channel.desc: In this episode of Catholic Canada, host Francis Denis travels to the Maritime provinces to discover a faith as steadfast as the region?s rugged coastlines. He explores the dynamic work of NET Canada, a youth ministry inspiring renewal across the country, and meets Bishop Christian Riesbeck CC, Bishop of Saint John, New Brunswick, who shares his vision for the Church in today?s world. (30 minutes).
